newsitem.title: POLAND: Merrill revises down BRE income forecast.
newsitem.headline: Merrill revises down BRE income forecast.

text.p: Merrill Lynch revised down its 1996 net income forecast for Polish Bank Rozwoju Eksportu SA (BRE) to 140 million zlotys because its net interest margin in the year's first half declined quicker than expected.
Merrill had previously forecast a 144 million zloty net profit.

In a report dated August 23 Merrill said annualised net interest margin for the first half fell surprisingly fast to 7.9 percent, causing it also to lower its 1997 net income forecast for BRE to 177 million zlotys from 190 million zlotys.

But the report kept its "neutral" rating on BRE shares in the intermediate term and "accumulate" rating for the longer term, citing the bank's 7.7 price-earnings ratio on forecast earnings for this year and price-net-asset-value ratio of two.

"This is the highest market valuation among the major (Warsaw bourse) banks, but we consider it merited by BRE's strong management track record, low cost base and potential to grow both organically and through sector consolidation," the report said.
